presets.name: Family with children
presets.description: Good schools and nurseries, safe streets, clean air and green space. Nightlife and the trip to the centre count less.

presets.name: Renter who works in the centre
presets.description: A short trip to work, a rent you can pay, and a lively place after work. Buying a home does not count.

presets.name: Retired
presets.description: Health care close by, quiet and safe streets, and low running costs. Schools and jobs do not count, and a quiet street is better than a busy one.

presets.name: Student
presets.description: A cheap rent, easy travel and a lively city. Council tax does not count, because students do not pay it, and neither does buying a home.
